card.name: Section numbers in warnings cross-references
card.fires_on: The space or opening piece right before a section number like 5.1 or 5.3 in warning cross-references, and the start of a warning heading such as Acute or Bullous right after such a number.

modes.label: Before a section number
modes.description: A blank space after an opening parenthesis, just before a warnings section number.

modes.label: Start of a warning heading
modes.description: The first piece of a warning title like Acute or Bullous that follows a section number.

card.plain: It fires at the point where a label's highlights or warnings list points to a numbered section, or where a numbered warning heading begins.
